mil3.1.9:1.2: “Venerable Nāgasena, when you say ‘and other skillful qualities’, what are those skillful qualities?”
mil3.1.9:1.3: “Ethics, Great King, faith, energy, mindfulness, and immersion—these are those skillful qualities.”
mil3.1.9:1.5: “Great King, ethics has the characteristic of being a foundation for all skillful qualities. Ethics is the foundation of the faculties, powers, awakening factors, factors of the path, kinds of mindfulness meditation, right efforts, bases of psychic power, absorptions, liberations, immersions, and attainments. Great King, a practitioner who is established in ethics, relying on ethics and standing on ethics, develops the five faculties—the faculty of faith, the faculty of energy, the faculty of mindfulness, the faculty of immersion, and the faculty of wisdom—and none of the skillful qualities decline.”
mil3.1.9:2.2: “Just as, Great King, all those kinds of seeds and plants that reach growth, increase, and abundance do so relying on the earth, established on the earth;
mil3.1.9:2.3: in the same way, Great King, a practitioner, relying on ethics and established in ethics, develops the five faculties: the faculty of faith, the faculty of energy, the faculty of mindfulness, the faculty of immersion, and the faculty of wisdom.”
mil3.1.9:3.2: “Just as, Great King, all those tasks that require strength are carried out relying on the earth, established on the earth;
mil3.1.9:3.3: in the same way, Great King, a practitioner, relying on ethics and established in ethics, develops the five faculties: the faculty of faith, the faculty of energy, the faculty of mindfulness, the faculty of immersion, and the faculty of wisdom.”
mil3.1.9:4.2: “Just as, Great King, a city builder who wants to lay out a city first has the site cleared, has the stumps and thorns removed, and has the ground leveled; and afterwards, having divided it up by marking out streets, crossroads, intersections, and so on, he builds the city;
mil3.1.9:4.3: in the same way, Great King, a practitioner, relying on ethics and established in ethics, develops the five faculties: the faculty of faith, the faculty of energy, the faculty of mindfulness, the faculty of immersion, and the faculty of wisdom.”
mil3.1.9:5.2: “Just as, Great King, an acrobat who wants to display his skill has the ground dug up, has the gravel and potsherds removed, has the ground leveled, and displays his skill on soft ground;
mil3.1.9:5.3: in the same way, Great King, a practitioner, relying on ethics and established in ethics, develops the five faculties: the faculty of faith, the faculty of energy, the faculty of mindfulness, the faculty of immersion, and the faculty of wisdom.
